scenarios.name: Fictional Alder Warehouse
scenarios.workload: Inventory and reservations across two warehouses
scenarios.required_behavior: Current availability requires qualified source snapshot; physical shelf status remains unknown.

scenarios.name: Fictional Copper Remodeling
scenarios.workload: Change orders and a future-effective material substitution
scenarios.required_behavior: Keep signed scope, later proposals and approved exceptions distinct.

scenarios.name: Fictional Juniper Restaurant Group
scenarios.workload: Chef and general manager discuss recipe costs and staffing separately
scenarios.required_behavior: Retrieve authorized department evidence without exposing HR notes to kitchen role.

scenarios.name: Fictional Fieldline Landscaping
scenarios.workload: Reschedule recurring jobs after a changed forecast export
scenarios.required_behavior: Treat forecast as time-bound source and schedules as separate authoritative state.

scenarios.name: Fictional Northstar Auto Retail
scenarios.workload: Deposit and vehicle availability across locations
scenarios.required_behavior: Same display model name is not vehicle identity; a drafted reservation is not a paid deposit.

scenarios.name: Fictional Cedar HVAC
scenarios.workload: Parts substitutions and a technician work-order handoff
scenarios.required_behavior: Learn useful local procedure but preserve source schema and approval preconditions.

scenarios.name: Fictional Meridian Property Services
scenarios.workload: Maintenance work and owner/tenant contact permissions
scenarios.required_behavior: Cross-property context never grants access to another owner’s records.

scenarios.name: Fictional Rivet Fabrication
scenarios.workload: Bill of materials and revised machine/tool constraints
scenarios.required_behavior: Review every required component, units and version; partial retrieval is not completeness.

scenarios.name: Fictional Pine Accounting Operations
scenarios.workload: Monthly invoice matching with late credits and duplicate imports
scenarios.required_behavior: Deterministic cents arithmetic, snapshot/coverage evidence and temporal correction.

scenarios.name: Fictional Harbor Retail Cooperative
scenarios.workload: Product aliases, bundles and cross-location stock counts
scenarios.required_behavior: Keep entity identity and bundle conversions explicit; do not merge similar names.

scenarios.name: Fictional Signal Software Studio
scenarios.workload: Repository migration across repeated context windows
scenarios.required_behavior: Preserve exact test evidence, unresolved failures and task authority after restart.

scenarios.name: Fictional Atlas Professional Services
scenarios.workload: Long project history with changed client deliverables
scenarios.required_behavior: Abstain on missing authorizations and recover source clauses rather than inventing them.
